prompt:

Asset type: individual production background illustration for a Bible Journey passage reader, landscape 1536×1024, full frame, no interface or text.

Composition/framing: Wide three-quarter view at seated height. Keep Jesus, Peter, basin, towel, and the watching disciples fully within the left 65%; reserve the right 30% as quiet wall and floor for a reading panel. Keep the top and bottom 12% free of essential subjects. One continuous scene, no collage or sequential panels.
Style/materials: Warm cinematic realistic historical illustration; worn linen and wool, simple wooden seating, clay basin and water, natural hands and faces, soft lamplight with warm earth tones.
Constraints: The visible action is Jesus washing Peter’s feet and Peter questioning him. Keep all people clothed and dignified. No modern furnishings, exact room claims, text, lettering, labels, pins, logos, border, watermark, or supernatural effects.
notes: Root inspected the full final raster and its named subjects. Hotspot coordinates were checked against the accepted image. Appearance and setting are illustrative; literary images are labeled in the reader.
